title: NBA Jersey Quiz Part 2: Hard Mode
headline: NBA Jersey Quiz Part 2: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Jersey
description: A hard NBA jersey quiz: eight tiny squares cut from current NBA jerseys, no numbers, no wordmarks, no logos. Just a collar, an armhole trim or a side panel. Guess the team, reveal the answer, keep score.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NBA jersey, about one fiftieth of the whole picture. No numbers, no wordmarks, no logo patches. What is left is the stuff fans stop noticing: the trim around an armhole, a pinstripe, a side panel.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.hint: Hard mode. No numbers, no logos.
items.piece: Black and white trim around the armhole of the red jersey.
items.fact: Chicago's red jersey keeps the trim simple: thin black and white bands around the neck and both armholes.

items.piece: Thin white pinstripes on the teal jersey.
items.fact: North Carolina designer Alexander Julian created the original teal pinstriped Hornets uniforms for the team's first season in 1988.

items.piece: The silver side panel, edged in white, on the black jersey.
items.fact: The franchise switched to black, silver and white when it moved from Dallas to San Antonio in 1973.

items.piece: The yellow side panel, with a white stripe, on the red jersey.
items.fact: Houston's red jersey has thin pinstripes on the body and a yellow panel running down each side.

items.piece: Red stripes split by a white stripe on the side of the royal blue jersey.
items.fact: Detroit's royal blue jersey has red and white stripes running down each side, from the armhole to the hem.

items.piece: The white band across the red jersey, with white armhole trim above it.
items.fact: Washington dropped blue and gold and went back to red, white and blue in 2011, the colors of its Bullets years.

items.piece: Orange and navy trim around the armhole of the blue jersey.
items.fact: When the team launched in 2008, chairman Clay Bennett said the blue came from the Oklahoma state flag and the orange from the sunset.

items.piece: The gold side panel on the navy jersey.
items.fact: The navy, gold and red date to the team's 2013 change from Hornets to Pelicans; the team said the blue came from Louisiana's state flag.
